title: Glowing diamond
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#aefafc' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#5fd8ff' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3aa8d8' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='top' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#eaffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8fe8f0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='left' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5cc8e8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7fe2f2'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='right' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8fe8f0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#48b0d4'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bottom' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#6fd4ea'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2f8fb8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- crown: table facets -->
  <polygon points='50,14 28,32 50,32' fill='url(#top)'/>
  <polygon points='50,14 50,32 72,32' fill='#c9f7fb'/>
  <polygon points='28,32 50,32 38,46' fill='url(#left)'/>
  <polygon points='50,32 72,32 62,46' fill='url(#right)'/>
  <polygon points='38,46 50,32 62,46 50,56' fill='#b6f2f8'/>

  <!-- girdle sparkle line -->
  <polygon points='30,58 38,46 62,46 70,58' fill='#a2eef6'/>

  <!-- pavilion -->
  <polygon points='30,58 38,46 50,56 50,88' fill='url(#left)'/>
  <polygon points='70,58 62,46 50,56 50,88' fill='url(#right)'/>
  <polygon points='38,46 50,56 62,46 50,64' fill='url(#bottom)' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- facet highlights -->
  <polygon points='50,14 34,30 50,30' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.75'/>
  <polygon points='36,48 44,48 44,54 36,52' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.55'/>
  <polygon points='56,50 60,56 52,60' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <path d='M50 4 L52 10 L58 12 L52 14 L50 20 L48 14 L42 12 L48 10 Z'/>
    <path d='M84 30 L85 34 L89 35 L85 36 L84 40 L83 36 L79 35 L83 34 Z' opacity='0.9'/>
    <path d='M16 66 L17 70 L21 71 L17 72 L16 76 L15 72 L11 71 L15 70 Z' opacity='0.9'/>
  </g>
</svg>
